Release notes

What is new in AviQuiz, newest version first. Release dates record when a release is packaged and tagged, and remain the same in staging and production.

v0.2.0-alpha.3

Release date: November 28, 2026

This alpha improves geography quiz support and clarifies the release history. It includes all features and improvements from v0.2.0-alpha.2.

  • Geography quiz improvements to support expanding coverage, while preserving North Carolina and Colombia seasonal quizzes, family filters, photo credits, and seasonal photo selection.
  • Release notes list the newest versions first, clearly identify updates included from earlier candidates, and use a consistent release date.

v0.2.0-alpha.2

Release date: November 28, 2026

Includes all features and improvements from v0.2.0-alpha.1, plus consistent navigation across pages.

  • Consistent header links to the quiz builder, practice, trips, and statistics across the site.
  • English and Colombian Spanish interfaces, with a language selector and localized labels, help, dialogs, and application messages.
  • Colombia-wide seasonal species coverage, with quizzes for the country, departments, and supported sites. Photo quizzes include species with available photos; coverage continues to expand.
  • Photo selection prefers the quarters in your seasonal window: January–March, April–June, July–September, and October–December. Windows spanning quarters can use either; other photo dates are used when matching photos are unavailable.
  • Optional signed-in statistics across devices, cumulative identification history and latest-result comparisons, browser-statistics consent, and import of older browser statistics. Guest quizzes remain available without an account.

v0.2.0-alpha.1

Release date: November 27, 2026

All changes in this candidate are included in v0.2.0-alpha.2.

This alpha expands seasonal practice across Colombia, adds Spanish, and brings optional account-based statistics to AviQuiz.

  • English and Colombian Spanish interfaces, with a language selector and localized labels, help, dialogs, and application messages.
  • Colombia-wide seasonal species coverage, with quizzes for the country, departments, and supported sites. Photo quizzes include species with available photos; coverage continues to expand.
  • Photo selection prefers the quarters in your seasonal window: January–March, April–June, July–September, and October–December. Windows spanning quarters can use either; other photo dates are used when matching photos are unavailable.
  • Optional signed-in statistics across devices, cumulative identification history and latest-result comparisons, browser-statistics consent, and import of older browser statistics. Guest quizzes remain available without an account.

v0.1.0-alpha.1

Release date: November 24, 2026

The first public alpha brings visual and audio bird-identification practice to aviquiz.org.

  • Photo and audio quizzes with site and family filters, mistake review, and separate visual/audio progress.
  • North Carolina seasonal geography quizzes, alongside the original Colombia itinerary and practice material.
  • Invitation-based accounts and guest quizzes open to everyone.
